# Type Alias EdgeItem

EdgeItem: [Edge](../classes/Edge.html) | [ChainElement](ChainElement.html)[]

An item that can be parsed into workflow edges: an explicit [Edge](../classes/Edge.html), or a chain expressed as an array of [ChainElement](ChainElement.html)s (e.g. `['START', nodeA, nodeB]`).
